decisions.reason: As a close-to-core yogurt variant with an early quality signal and relatively low carrying cost, it is still worth keeping unless clearly weak sales now emerge.

Because it was positioned as a flagship cheese and fits the firm's core organic cheese business, management would usually continue it unless several years of market experience had clearly disproved its value.
By 2022 the learning value from this multi-variant spicy cheese line is largely exhausted, and if it has not become a strong seller the added SKU complexity is no longer worth keeping.
Its narrower washed-rind taste profile and likely higher sales risk mean that, after several years without strong evidence of traction, the option value of continuing is low.
